comments.author: Northerner
comments.body:
High throwing is really badass. The Yat and Katz will be all you need until we get the rest of East Asia. It's very easy to add +6-8 through equipment, without sacrificing too much defense.

Get a good adventure job like Ruin Explorer or Guerrilla, that favours throwing and trap, and you'll be set. Remember that raising adventure is what raises your attack rating - not battle, but you'll get good adventure xp from land battle while in these jobs and using throwing and trap.

comments.author: Lena
comments.body: I have a noob question bought techs. I’m a noob adventure and don’t battles at all except for land battle, the tech I use right now is poison dart trap, and fuse explosive. I’m finding this very over powering but some boss mobs seem to be immune they almost always resist the effect. Anyway should I be concentrating only on trapping like I have been, or do I still need to level throwing battle tech? If I do need battle tech what is the best way to grind both? Would it be better to use what I am using and turn on one battle tech, or turn off trap techs and grind them separate so it’s easier to get a combo?

comments.author: Rashid
comments.body: Traps are good actives to use, but if your an adventure throwing is good, if you have something like the thief profession you can also use swordplay. But having some sort of base weapon to do constant damage is important in my opinion. Hope this helps.
